criteria.name: Intent Understanding
criteria.description: Did the agent correctly understand the user's needs and questions?

criteria.name: Accuracy
criteria.description: Were the agent’s responses factually correct and relevant?

criteria.name: Clarity
criteria.description: Were the responses clear, structured, and easy to understand?

criteria.name: Helpfulness
criteria.description: Did the agent provide useful guidance or solutions?

criteria.name: Professional Tone
criteria.description: Was the agent polite, professional, and appropriate?

criteria.name: Task Completion
criteria.description: Did the agent successfully guide the user toward completing their goal?
